reviews.text: They always treat Trufa so well! She always looks so pretty. Silvia is very kind.
I definitely recommend it.

Amazing dog grooming salon.

I've tried several in Madrid, and I think this is definitely my favorite.
The service is impeccable, both for the dogs and their owners. And the work they do is magnificent.
I leave very happy. I'll definitely be back. I recommend it 100,000%.
They're so sweet.

I've had the pleasure of meeting Silvia, who, along with her colleagues, does the wonderful work they do with so much love, and it shows. It's evident in the way they treat their furry clients and the top-quality professional care they provide. You can tell they love what they do. And you can tell their clients know it, judging by how beautiful their pets look.
I simply love them! Silvia is the best, she has a love for dogs that's like a gift from heaven, and my Gretel is always well cared for and pampered and looks absolutely beautiful!

I just picked up my dog ​​Malta from Silvia. She's a Shih Tzu. She left super happy and looking adorable! Silvia is very attentive to the owners' preferences and makes sure they're happy. 100% recommended! Thank you!

The love and dedication they put into their work is admirable, and it shows in the final result.

Thank you so much!

Today I took my puppy Ricky for a wash and haircut, and he looks fantastic! I'm thrilled with the result. Silvia, the groomer, was so friendly and treated him with so much care.
A 10 out of 10! I highly recommend it.

Taking my dog ​​to this groomer is always a great decision. Silvia is a true professional: caring, patient, and incredibly meticulous. From the very first moment, she inspires confidence, and it's clear she loves animals and pays attention to every detail so they leave not only looking their best, but also relaxed and happy.

The results are impeccable, and the service, both to the dogs and their owners, is friendly and honest. Without a doubt, a highly recommended place.
We are very happy, my dog ​​came out of the groomer looking handsome and happy

100% recommended. Silvia is lovely. You can tell she loves her job.
We've been taking our Goldendoodle to the groomer for a few months now, and we're always thrilled with the results.
To be honest, I'm always a little nervous about getting a buzz cut in case the hair ends up too short, but Silvia does an amazing job. She gives great advice and always respects my preferences, although I've already followed some of her suggestions. Maya is always delighted to go.
They are incredibly kind and treated my rescued (and timid) dog with so much love. 100% recommended!
Silvia is so sweet with them, you can tell she enjoys what she does, pampering them, and she's a fantastic hairdresser... highly recommended 😉 …
Silvia is a very kind person ❤️

100% recommended. Silvia, the owner, is lovely and always has a smile on her face. You can tell she loves her job, and she was incredibly gentle with my furry friend, a Siberian Husky who's quite a handful to bathe and de-shed. She spent practically the entire afternoon with her and was very careful and meticulous. When I went back to pick her up, she looked absolutely gorgeous! I was absolutely delighted with the service, the attention, and the price. Dog Lovers will definitely be the only groomer I take her to from now on. A real find near Retiro Park.

Some friends from Retiro Park, where I usually take my Akana, had recommended this grooming salon to me.

And I couldn't have been more surprised, satisfied, and happy with the work Silvia (the owner) does. I've never seen anyone enjoy their work so much and give so much love to dogs.
She treated my Akana, a beautiful Siberian Husky, with extraordinary tenderness, love, and gentleness, even though my dog ​​isn't very friendly with strangers and tends to nip at them 🤣🤣... Besides, it's incredible how skillfully she handles the scissors and uses high-quality shampoos. She trimmed all the fur off my husky and left her looking like a plush toy... and after two days she still smells amazing!!!... And she charged me considerably less than other places I've taken her to before. Her prices are competitive for the quality she offers... she spent almost three hours with my Akana... what patience!!!! And without ever losing her affection or her smile!!...the result was spectacular!!!
Not only is she now my go-to groomer, but I plan to recommend her to all my friends for their furry friends...oh, I almost forgot...she's an expert groomer, judging by what I've seen on her social media, with all kinds of dogs (poodles, bichons, Australian Cattle Dogs...she makes any of them look like a million bucks...THANK YOU SO MUCH, SILVIA!!!

I have a Chow Chow and he did a perfect job grooming him. Plus, he always keeps the same price, unlike other places that make up prices based on age and other absurd things. Highly recommended, and I have the most demanding breed when it comes to coat care. In my case, everything was perfect.

I took Leo to Dog Lovers for the first time and I'm thrilled. He not only looked gorgeous but was also incredibly happy. He usually hates haircuts and tries to escape at all costs, but today when I went to pick him up he was so content he wanted to stay! Highly recommended, we'll definitely be back! Thank you so much ♥️

Today was my dog ​​Tina's grooming day. She's a long-haired Jack Russell and got a stripped cut. As always, they made her look gorgeous. Silvia is a sweetheart, very careful and affectionate with the dogs. I couldn't be happier.

A 5-star experience for my furry friend! I took my Westie to Doglovers and couldn't be happier with the service.

From the moment we walked in, Silvia demonstrated impeccable professionalism. She explained the process in detail, recommended the best cut for my pet's breed and needs, and showed a deep understanding of canine care.

What impressed me most was the care and patience with which they treated my dog.

The result was spectacular: a perfect cut, a shiny coat, and most importantly, my dog ​​left happy and relaxed!

The salon was spotless, which reinforces their commitment to hygiene and the well-being of pets. It's definitely a place where professionalism and love for animals go hand in hand.

We'll be back soon! ;)

Highly recommended for those who want the best for their furry friends.

I took my dog, a Westie, to the groomer, and I couldn't be happier. Silvia is wonderful; she treated my dog ​​like he was her own, and the result was spectacular: his coat is gorgeous, perfectly styled. Highly recommended groomer; I'll definitely be back.
Silvia stripped my Dachshund and he looked gorgeous! She was incredibly helpful and my dog ​​was so happy. 😊 …

I've tried several dog groomers, and I dare say this is the best dog groomer in Madrid. I have three dogs: a poodle, a bichon fries, and a wirehaired dachshund. Silvia does a fantastic job with stripping, and she's made my other two dogs look gorgeous. She's a 10 out of 10 as a professional.

From the moment you arrive, it's a completely positive experience. Silvia's attention is delightful; you can tell she loves animals, and her professionalism is outstanding. We are thrilled with everything.
I loved it! I left my dog ​​there, and Silvia, the owner, greeted me warmly with a smile. She did a fantastic job caring for my dog.
We are delighted with everything; my dog ​​looks fantastic, and Silvia, the new owner, is a sweetheart and a true professional. We will definitely be back. Thank you for everything.
Silvia is a sweetheart; you can tell she puts a lot of love into her work. Quality products, excellent workmanship, and patience and love for our furry friends—the perfect combination! 👏🏻 …

Yesterday I took my dog ​​for a haircut. Silvia, the owner, is a delight; she greets you with a smile and treats the dogs exceptionally well.
We were thrilled with the work; she's a true professional. 100% recommended.
We'll be back.

Susana is wonderful. She always greets dogs with affection and makes them look gorgeous, but most importantly, she takes her time and it's not stressful for them. Mine used to be terrified, but thanks to Susana and her equally wonderful assistant (sorry I can't remember her name!), they now go without any problem as part of their routine and are happy to see them. 100% Recommended. For me, the best in the neighborhood!

I'm delighted with the service. Whenever I'm in Madrid, I leave my dog ​​in their care. She has long, double-coated hair, sometimes with stubborn knots—it's definitely not easy to manage. They cut her hair beautifully, leaving her looking gorgeous, and I think they treat her well because she's never scared when I take her. I'm so happy with them, thank you always!
Today we had my dog ​​given a hand-stripping haircut and it was fantastic, everything was perfect thanks to Susana's care and dedication. Thank you so much.

I took him yesterday for a haircut and bath. When I got home, he looked clean and well-groomed. After about an hour, I noticed he couldn't open his left eye. I took him to the vet, and they said he got some soap in his eye, and he also developed an ulcer. I don't recommend this place.
Friendly, fast, and efficient service; very kind and caring with pets. My dog ​​Valkiria looked spotless… I'll definitely be back!

I think it's simply the best dog groomer in Madrid, and not just because of how great my dog ​​Mateo looks, but because it's a place where they treat dogs incredibly well and genuinely care about them. After discovering this place, I never took my dog ​​anywhere else. I'm so glad I found it, and they make dogs look gorgeous without charging an arm and a leg like most places. I highly recommend it.

I took my dog ​​there for the first time since the groomer I usually took her to closed down. When I went to pick her up, she was very happy and they had done a fantastic job. Very satisfied with the service.
Very professional, I'm very happy with Susana, she understands my dog ​​very well.
Bruna and Tammy provided amazing service. They were very attentive and friendly.

Thank you so much, Amor, for your review.
We hope to see you soon at Dog Lovers!
Thank you so much.
Thank you so much, Lesslie, for your review. We're delighted to have you back again.
